citation: Parpola, Asko. 1994. Deciphering the Indus Script. Cambridge: Cambridge University Press. xxii + 374 pp., 226 figs. ISBN 0521430798 / 9780521430791. First published 1994.
notes: Secondary monograph by chief editor of the Corpus of Indus Seals and Inscriptions. Publisher/catalog (accessed 2026-10-11): nearly 4,000 inscribed samples survive, mainly stamp seals and amulets; no bilingual translations. Parpola advances a logo-syllabic / Proto-Dravidian hypothesis — that decipherment proposal is NOT adopted as fact in this project. Use only for: (1) corpus size/media orientation; (2) research-status fact that no generally accepted decipherment exists; (3) paleographic orientation. Contested readings belong in civilization Notes, not fact columns.
